spans.s:
m. (-शः)
1 An egg.
2 Wrought or unwrought gold or silver plate, jewellery.
3 An ordeal, &c.
f. (-शी)
1 A shoe, a sandal.
2 The beard of corn.
E.
कुश or कुष to issue, घञ् affix, fem. affix ङीष्; see कोष.

mn. (-षः-षं)
1 A bud.
2 A sheathe, a scabbard, &c.
3 A coat, a surrounding cover, any investing sheathe.
4 Judicial trial by oath or ordeal, or by fire, water, poison, the balance, heated balls of iron, boiling oil, &c. attesting a deity, and touching or drinking water three times in which some idol has been washed.
5 Gold or silver, wrought or unwrought, as plate, jewellery, &c.
6

Wealth.
7

Accumulated wealth, treasure.
8 A treasury, the apartment where money or plate is kept.
9 A sacrificial vessel or any drinking vessel.
10 The vulva, the womb.
11 The penis.
12 A testicle or the scrotum.
13 An egg.
14 (In composition,) A ball or globe, as सूत्रकीष a ball of thread, नेत्रकोष the eyeball, &c.
15 The inner part of the Jack-fruit or its like.
16 A nutmeg.
17 A dictionary or vocabulary.
f. (-षी)
1 A shoe, a sandal.
2 The beard of corn: see कोश.
E.
कुश or कुष to issue, affix घञ्; hence the word is optionally कोष or कोश; the meanings may be mostly resolved into, that from which something issues or evolves.

m. (-रः)
The sugar cane; also कोषकार.

m. (-रः)
1 Sugar cane, or a variety.
2 The silk worm, or the insect while in its cocoon.
3 A chrysalis, or (pupa.)
E.
कोश a sheathe, and कार what makes; also कोशकार or with कन् added कोशकारक and कोशकारक.

n. (-लं)
A berry containing a waxy and fragrant substance: see कक्कोल.
E.
कोश an egg, फल fruit; the berry being egg-shaped.

n. (-लं)
A berry having a fragrant pulp: see कक्वोल.
m. (-लः)
A kind of creeping plant: see घोषक.
f. (-ला)
A sort of Ghoṣa with yellow flowers.
E.
कोष a sheathe, and फल fruit; also कोशफल.

mf. (-लः-ला)
1 A name of the city Ayodhya (Oude), or the neighbouring district.
2 The name of a prince.
E.
कुश to shine, अल Uṇādi affix; also कोषल.

f. (-ला)
The country south of Ayodhya (Oude), or Ayodhya itself: see कोशला.

f. (-जा)
The wife of DAŚARATHA the mother of RĀMA.
E.
कोशल the name of a king, and आत्मजा a daughter.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Wrapped up in a sheathe or shell, &c.
m. (-सी)
1 A shelled animal.
2 A chrysalis or pupa.
E.
कोश, and वासिन् what abides.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Sheathed, enveloped in a sheathe, a shell, &c.
m. (-स्थः)
1 Any shelled insect or animal, as a snail, &c.
2 A pupa or chrysalis.
3 The silk worm in its cocoon.
E.
कोश, and स्थ what abides.

n. (-कं)
A bribe.
E.
कोश or कोष wealth, and ल what takes, ठक् affix; also कोषलिक.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A kind of reed or grass, commonly Ikāda.
E.
कोश or कोष a sheathe, and अङ्ग body; also कोषाङ्ग.

m. (-कः)
Hair.
f. (-की)
Several sorts of cucurbitaceous plants: see कोषातक.

m. (-कः)
Hair.
f. (-की)
1 A small species of cucumber, (Trichosanthes diaeca.)
2 A cucurbitaceous plant, commonly called Turai, (Luffa acutangula.)
3 Another kind, (L. pentangula.)
4 A kind of creeper: see घोष.
5 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera); also अपामार्ग.
6 Night.
E.
कोष a sheathe, &c. अत to go, affixes क्वुन् and ङीष्; also कोशातक and कोषातकी.

f. (-की)
1 Trade, business.
2 A trader, a merchant.
3 Submarine fire.

m. (-कः)
1 An egg.
2 A testicle.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

n. (-णं)
Undergoing an ordeal.
E.
कोष, and ग्रहण taking; also कोशग्रहणं.

m. (-ञ्चुः)
The Indian crane.
E.
कोष a sheathe, &c. and चञ्चु a beak.

m. (-कः)
1 The Indian

Plutus.
2

A treasurer.
E.
कोष, and नायक chief.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Treasured, stored, accumulated.
E.
कोष, and भूत been.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Rich, wealthy.
E.
कोष, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-द्धिः)
Swelled testicle, enlargement of the scrotum, from hernia or hydrocele, &c.
E.
कोष a testicle, and वृद्धि increase.

f. (-का)
A knife.
E.
कोष a scabbard, and शी to sleep, ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-द्धिः)
Purification by ordeal.
E.
कोष, and शुद्धि purity; also कोशशृद्धि.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Poor, without treasure.
E.
कोष, and हीन deprived of.

m. (-शः)
Part of a treasure, a portion of a person's wealth.
E.
कोष, and अंश part.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A treasurer.
2 KUVERA.
E.
कोष, and अध्यक्ष superintendant.

n. (-णं)
Carrying off treasure.
E.
कोष, and अपहरण taking away.

m. (-षी)
The mango tree.
E.
कोष a sheathe, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Own.
m. (-ष्ठः)
1 A granary, a place in which grain is kept.
2 A treasury.
3 An apartment.
4 Any viscus, as the heart, lungs, stomach, bowels, &c.
E.
कुष to issue, थन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-कं)
1 A granary.
2 A treasury.
3 A brick trough for watering cattle at.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-लः)
1 A municipal officer, a constable.
2 A watch, a guard.
3 A storekeeper, a treasurer.
E.
कोष्ठ the granary, &c. and पाल who protects.

m. (-रः)
1 A store.
2 A treasury.
E.
कोष्ठ, and आगार a house.

m. (-ग्निः)
The digestive faculty, the gastric juice.
E.
कोष्ठ stomach, and अग्नि fire.

mfn. (-ष्णः-ष्णा-ष्णं)
Warm, moderately warm, tepid.
n. (-ष्णं)
Warmth.
E.
का diminutive, and उष्ण warm.
